# @mod-internal/ui design tokens

CSS custom properties available once `mod.css` or `mod-core.css` is loaded, with their light-mode values. Dark mode (`data-theme="dark"` on `<html>`) overrides many of them, so reference the variable, never its value. Search for a prefix (`--mod-primary`, `--spacing`, `--radius`, `--color-error`) rather than reading everything.
